## Change Package: OTLP Ingress Sender-Restriction (TCP 4317/4318)

**Leg type: CONFIG-AUTHORING.** Replaces the unrestricted `allow all;` grant on both OTLP server blocks in `otlp-ingress.conf` with the chained `exporterRangeCidr` as sole permitted sender. No other file, listener, or system is touched. Apply is out-of-band (operator-gated `nginx -s reload`) — this package is the pre-apply runbook, never an applied change.

### Branch conditions — carried forward from Phase 1 Architect, not re-answered

| Row | Answer | Deciding read | Outcome applied |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target-empty / enforcer-absent` (combined, declared precedence) | **NOT CONFIRMED** | Both server blocks carry explicit `allow all;` stanzas — configuration exists | Precedence row does not fire |
| `existing-grant` | **CONFIRMED** | Explicit `allow all;` in both blocks; file header documents brownfield baseline | **Replace** applied on both ports |
| `target-absent` | **NOT CONFIRMED** | `stack_health`: `otel_collector: up`; both server blocks present | N/A |
| `principal-unseen` | **UNTESTED** | No tool on the read-only surface inspects docker-network/NAT/LB topology between exporter and nginx; neither block sets `set_real_ip_from`/`real_ip_header`/`proxy_protocol` | Change authored regardless, per contract — listed under **UNTESTED premises** below |

**UNTESTED premises:** `observability-config.principal-unseen` — whether nginx evaluates the exporter's true, unmodified source address (vs. a NAT/LB-rewritten one) at `allow`/`deny` evaluation time could not be confirmed on this read-only surface. This is a genuine enforcement-fidelity gap, not closed by this package.

---

### Desired-State Config — `otlp-ingress.conf`

⚠️ **Fidelity note (named, not fabricated):** §6 carried the Architect's prose/table *restatement* of the harvested file's directives, not a fenced verbatim quote under a `## Harvested Allocations`-style heading (confirmed: this predecessor emitted no such block). The reconstruction below uses only directive names/values the Architect explicitly stated. Two placements are genuinely ambiguous from that restatement and are flagged inline as **ASSUMPTIONS**, not witnessed facts. **Operator: diff this against the live file before applying.**

```nginx
# otlp-ingress.conf — DESIRED STATE (the two in-scope server blocks; operator-access.conf is a
# separate file, out of scope, unchanged — see "No-Change Target" below)

server {
    listen 4317;
    http2 on;                                      # ASSUMPTION: server-level placement — Architect
                                                    # named "http2 on;" as a block characteristic but
                                                    # did not state its exact line position

    location / {
        allow 10.99.0.0/27;                        # NEW — exporterRangeCidr, sole permitted sender
        deny all;                                  # CHANGED from: allow all;
        grpc_pass grpc://172.31.114.10:4317;        # unchanged
    }
}

server {
    listen 4318;

    location / {
        allow 10.99.0.0/27;                        # NEW — exporterRangeCidr, sole permitted sender
        deny all;                                  # CHANGED from: allow all;
        proxy_pass http://172.31.114.10:4318;       # unchanged
        client_max_body_size 16m;                   # unchanged
        proxy_set_header Host $host;                # unchanged (value inferred — Architect
                                                      # restated only header name, not value)
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $remote_addr;  # unchanged (value inferred similarly)
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_actr;    # unchanged, PRESERVED VERBATIM INCLUDING TYPO —
                                                      # Architect: harvested file shows this typo
                                                      # verbatim, "not to be corrected"; the HEADER
                                                      # NAME (X-Real-IP) is an ASSUMPTION — Architect
                                                      # stated only the mistyped value, not the
                                                      # directive name
    }
}
```

**No-Change Target:**

| File | Port | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `operator-access.conf` | 14318 | **Unchanged.** `allow 172.20.0.1; deny all;` stays exactly as-is. Out of scope — different purpose (operator demo-injection), different port. |

---

### Validation Steps (deterministic — command, then literal/comparison expected result)

**Step 1 — Pre-apply syntax check (generic validator, read before reload):**
```
docker exec obs-ingress nginx -t
```
**Expected output (static substrings only — the exact main-config file path nginx embeds in this message is this container's compiled-in default, not read by any harvest step, so it is omitted rather than guessed; the two invariant tokens nginx always prints on success are quoted literally):**
```
syntax is ok
test is successful
```
*(No `emerg` or `failed` token should appear anywhere in the command's output.)*

**Step 2 — Post-apply re-read of the ingress config (first-ever state — no harvest has ever observed the restricted rendering, so no literal is predicted; comparison per sanctioned shape):**
```
services(action:'call', targetService:'observability-readonly', tool:'get_ingress_config', arguments:{})
```
**Comparison (not a literal — reason: this is the first time the restricted config exists to be read):**
- `listen 4317` block, `location /` stanza: first line is exactly `allow 10.99.0.0/27;`, immediately followed by `deny all;`; no `allow all;` line remains.
- `listen 4318` block, `location /` stanza: same pair, same order.
- All other directives in both stanzas (`grpc_pass`, `http2 on;`, `proxy_pass`, `client_max_body_size 16m;`, all three `proxy_set_header` lines including the `$remote_actr` typo) present and byte-identical to pre-change — proves no collateral edit.
- `operator-access.conf`'s `allow 172.20.0.1; deny all;` stanza unchanged — proves the untouched-listener guarantee.

**Step 3 — Functional sender test (named gap, not fabricated):** Confirming an in-range sender succeeds and an out-of-range sender is refused on both ports requires live traffic injection, which is outside this package's read-only toolchain and outside the Author role's stack-contact permission. This is an **operator-lane action**, to be run post-reload, not before — no literal or comparison is authored here because no tool on this surface can produce the evidence.

---

### Rollback Plan

The forward edit is a narrow 2-line change per block (insert one `allow` line, flip `allow all;`→`deny all;`), so rollback does **not** depend on having the full original file — only on the Architect's own per-target table, which states the prior state for both blocks as `allow all;` with no `deny` line (quoted from that table, not a fenced verbatim capture — same fidelity caveat as above).

| Target | Rollback action |
|---|---|
| `otlp-ingress.conf`, `listen 4317` block | Remove `allow 10.99.0.0/27;`; change `deny all;` → `allow all;`. All other directives untouched throughout. |
| `otlp-ingress.conf`, `listen 4318` block | Same two-line reversal. |
| `operator-access.conf` | No rollback needed — never modified. |

Reload (`nginx -s reload`) required to activate the rollback, same blast radius as the forward apply (below).

---

### Change Ordering & Apply-Governance Note

1. **Pre-check (operator):** confirm `exporterRangeCidr = 10.99.0.0/27` is the final consumed value (program check 1) before editing.
2. **Edit `otlp-ingress.conf`, 4317 block first**, then **4318 block** — single file, one coherent diff (no technical ordering dependency between the two; file-authoring order only, per Architect).
3. **No edit to `operator-access.conf`.**
4. **Validate:** run Step 1 (`nginx -t`) before reload.
5. **Apply (out-of-band, operator-gated):** `docker exec obs-ingress nginx -s reload`. This is a **reload**, not a restart — graceful, no socket drop; old workers drain in-flight connections.
6. **Blast radius:** nginx reload re-parses the *entire* nginx instance's config in one atomic step — this transiently re-forks worker processes for **all** server blocks hosted by this nginx, including `operator-access.conf`'s listener on 14318, even though that block's declared configuration is unmodified (process-level mechanical fact of reload, not a config change to that listener). There is no way to stage 4317 ahead of 4318 at the reload step itself.
7. **Post-apply checks, in order:** Step 2 (config re-read comparison) → Step 3 (operator-lane functional test).
8. **Window:** no customer-facing maintenance window beyond the sub-second nginx reload — config-reload class of change, not a restart/redeploy.

---

### Collateral Effect (explicit, per task requirement)

> **Any sender outside `10.99.0.0/27` that was previously reaching TCP 4317 or TCP 4318 under `allow all;` loses access on those two ports once this change is applied. No other listener on this ingress is affected** — specifically `operator-access.conf` (port 14318, `allow 172.20.0.1; deny all;`) continues to permit exactly the same single sender as before, with no change to its declared access policy.

### Chosen-Value Rationale

No net-new numeric or form value is introduced by this package beyond the **consumed** `exporterRangeCidr` (`10.99.0.0/27`), which per contract is applied verbatim and never recomputed or chosen by this leg. `deny all;` is the fixed nginx default-deny idiom paired with an explicit allowlist — not a tunable value with sizing alternatives. No interval, threshold, retention window, memory limit, or refresh value is set or modified here. **No chosen-value comparison arithmetic applies to this package.**
